content: Tyre pressure light came on again, check them at the garage before the long drive.
MOT is due on the 14th, book the slot and ask about the rattle from the exhaust.
Glovebox: manual, spare bulbs, ice scraper, tyre inflator, parking permit.
The old Fiesta on its last day, 142,000 miles and still starting first time.
My car's check engine light is just a surprise subscription to bad news.
Soak the chickpeas overnight, then simmer with cumin, garlic and a squeeze of lemon.
Pancake day: flour, eggs, milk, lemon, sugar, a good frying pan.
Preheat the oven to 180C. Cream the butter and sugar, fold in the flour, bake for 25 minutes until golden.
Mum's trick for rice: rinse it three times and never lift the lid.
I followed the recipe exactly, which is why the smoke alarm and I are on first-name terms.
Call Gran on Sunday, she wants to hear about the new flat.
Dad's seventieth in June, my brother is sorting the restaurant and I am sorting the cake.
Cousins at the beach, all four of them asleep in the back of the van.
Aunt Carol is coming for the weekend, make up the spare room and hide the good biscuits.
Hi love, just to say we got home safe. Give the kids a kiss from us. Love Mum and Dad xx
Finished the whole series in one weekend, the last episode was worth the wait.
Watchlist: the new Villeneuve, that heist film with the twist, the documentary about bees.
Popcorn, blanket, rain on the window, and the film is about to start.
The lead actor was brilliant but the ending felt rushed, three stars.
Every thriller: someone says 'let's split up' and the audience groans in unison.
Leg day: squats five by five, then lunges, then a walk of shame to the stairs.
Warm-up: rowing machine ten minutes, hip openers, band pull-aparts.
New personal best on the bench, 70 kilos for three, spotter said I was shaking.
Sunrise run along the river, 8 km before breakfast.
Week 3: Monday upper body, Tuesday rest, Wednesday deadlifts, Thursday cardio, Friday full body circuits.
Blood test results back on Friday, ask the doctor about the cholesterol number.
Dentist at 3pm, remember the floss this time.
Prescription: ibuprofen with food, antihistamine at night, review in two weeks.
Back has been sore since Tuesday, booking a physio before it gets worse.
Your appointment with the GP is confirmed for Thursday at 10:40. Please bring a list of your current medication.
The boiler is losing pressure again, ring the engineer before the cold snap.
Weekend jobs: mow the lawn, clear the gutters, fix the squeaky door, bleed the radiators.
Paint the spare room a warm white, two coats, tape the skirting first.
The new sofa finally fits through the door, after one minor argument.
I do not have a messy house, I have a lived-in archaeological site.
Pay the credit card in full on the 3rd so there is no interest.
Bills this month: rent, electricity, broadband, phone, car insurance.
Moved two hundred into savings, the emergency fund is nearly at three months.
Your statement is ready. Minimum payment due 25 March. Balance 412.17. Interest charged this month 6.09.
My bank balance and my gym attendance are both in a long and silent decline.
Halfway through the new Atwood, the first hundred pages are slow but the voice is wonderful.
To read: the Ishiguro, that biography of Darwin, something light for the beach.
"It was a bright cold day in April, and the clocks were striking thirteen." Opening line of the novel, still gets me.
Library haul: five novels and a book of poems, due back in three weeks.
Book club on Thursday, I have not finished the last chapter and I am bluffing.
Flights to Lisbon are cheaper on a Tuesday, book before the price jumps.
Packing: passport, adaptor, sun cream, walking shoes, a spare charger.
Sunset over the harbour in Split, the best fish of the whole trip.
Hotel in Rome has a rooftop terrace, ask for the room facing the dome.
Your booking is confirmed. Check-in from 3pm. Late checkout available on request. Breakfast included.
Essay on Keynes due Friday, aim for 2,500 words and cite properly.
Lecture on thermodynamics at nine, bring the problem sheet.
Exam revision: past papers, flashcards for the formulas, ask the tutor about question four.
Reminder: seminar groups for next term are posted on the department board. Attendance is compulsory.
My degree is mostly turning caffeine into deadlines and then regret.
Client call moved to Thursday at 11, send the agenda tonight.
Monday: finish the quarterly report, reply to HR, one to one with Priya at 3.
Manager wants the budget draft by end of day, which is a surprise to me.
Team, the office will be closed on the 26th. Please log your hours and submit expenses before then.
The whole team at the offsite, everyone mid-laugh, nobody looking at the camera.
